content: MK's background: Temür took a dim view of Fażl Allāh Astarābādī, who was imprisoned and executed by Mīrānshāh b. Temür at Alinjaq in 796/1394; the site became a Hurufi pilgrimage focus and the sect ritually hostile to the dynasty; Shāhrukh's reign was punctuated by periodic Hurufi uprisings and he persecuted the group as a threat to the state. Fażl Allāh's doctrine puts Fażl Allāh himself at the centre as the Word.
